title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-002-004
doc_notes: This document is a collection of correspondence and requests sent to the FAA in Anchorage, Alaska, following public interest in the November 1986 Japan Air Lines UFO sighting.

incidents.summary: Japan Air Lines flight 1628 reported being shadowed by two belts of lights and a huge spaceship over Alaska.
incidents.quote: Japan Air Lines pilot reported that his jet was shadowed by two belts of lights
